tasks.short: Prepare reports of human factors tests and investigations.

steps.what: Pull results from the human factors tests.
Draft the report and the presentation from results.

loop.input: Result pack and the report headings
loop.check: A number not in the pack is deleted
loop.stop: One draft; a heading with no result stays empty
loop.why_not_simpler: The prose has to follow this test, not the last report

steps.what: Check conclusions against the investigation results.
Send the checked report to the client.

tasks.design: Test results are packed from {DOCS}, and the draft may use only those figures. The engineer checks every conclusion. The client receives the report only after that check. A presentation uses the same checked pack.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reports were rewritten from the previous study, and figures were pasted late.
tasks.enabler_now: A draft can start once results are a pack. The conclusions stay the engineer's.
tasks.still_hard: A smooth paragraph that goes beyond what the test showed.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer stops a conclusion the investigation does not support.

ambition.what: Give the people who were tested a short note of the checked findings, not only the client report.

tasks.altitude: Checking conclusions stays. The engineer can refuse to send a report with an unsourced figure.

reach.task: Trace a reported result to the test record
reach.learn: Which trace is enough before a human factors result is sent

evidence.claim: The engineer stays responsible for a finding that names a hazard, a person, or a design change.
A report can be drafted from records only if every number traces to a result the engineer accepts.

assumptions: Focal role is the human factors engineer. Boundary: from test results to the sent report. Running the test is out of scope.
Test a {DOCS} template before custom code.
Structured fields are result identity, value and source test. The test record produces them. Fallback: a typed figure cannot be sent until a source is named.
unknowns: Whether the audience is the client, the users, or both.
Which conclusions are allowed in a slide.
research_questions: Which findings need a retest before they are written as a conclusion?

already_counted.description: Editing thin sections of the draft

incremental.description: Keep headings and result fields aligned

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A finished test with a complete pack saves gathering and the first draft. Conclusions and the send stay. The low case is a report that must argue past the tables.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend workplace changes for loads and repetitive motions.

steps.what: Summarize loads and repetitive motions from the records.
Watch the heavy loads and repetitive motions.
Judge which workplace change would reduce the harm.
Supervisor says which changes the shift can run.
Recommend workplace changes for health and safety.

loop.output: Recommendation naming the change, the task and the limit
loop.check: Engineer removes a change the judgement did not keep
loop.stop: One draft; a change the supervisor cannot run is marked blocked
loop.why_not_simpler: The note must not read as a sanction on a named worker

tasks.design: Known loads can be summarized in {SPREADSHEET}. The engineer still watches the heavy or repetitive work and judges the change. The recommendation goes to the safety lead only after that judgement, and it does not score the worker.
tasks.previous_blocker: Load figures and the visit were separate, so recommendations repeated old wording.
tasks.enabler_now: A summary can be ready before the visit. The watch and the choice of change stay.
tasks.still_hard: A change that cuts a number and the shift cannot actually do.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer has seen the motion and will not recommend a change that moves the harm.

ambition.what: Recommend a change when the same load appears on two watches, not only after an injury.

tasks.altitude: Watching the job stays. The engineer can withhold a recommendation that names a worker rather than a task.

reach.task: Balance the line after a handling change
reach.learn: Which change cuts a load and adds a queue or a reach

evidence.claim: The engineer stays responsible for a finding that names a hazard, a person, or a design change.
A decision about a worker may not be solely automated.
Recording work so as to check behaviour or performance needs works-council consent.

assumptions: Focal role is the human factors engineer. Boundary: from task records and a watch to a recommendation. Implementing the change is the workplace's work.
Structured fields are task, load, repetition and proposed change. The task record produces the load. Fallback: the engineer types a load seen on the watch and marks it as observed.
No solely automated decision about a worker. Watches are not a performance score.
unknowns: Who can approve a workplace change.
research_questions: Which changes need occupational health before they are recommended?

already_counted.description: Judging changes the summary cannot rank

incremental.description: Keep task names aligned with the workplace

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A task with existing load data saves the summary. The watch, the judgement and the shift constraints stay. The low case is a job that has not been watched.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Measure tasks with checklists, video and force tools.

steps.what: Set the checklists for the task analysis.
Measure force and posture for the task analysis.
Do the videotaping of the task.
Reduce the force measurement to a table.

tasks.design: Checklists can be ready in {DOCS}, and force readings can be tabulated in {SPREADSHEET}. Measuring force, posture and the videotaping stay with the engineer, and only with consent. The anthropometric note is filed by the engineer, not taken from the table alone.
tasks.previous_blocker: Readings were copied off instruments after the session, and video had no agreed purpose.
tasks.enabler_now: The table can be filled from instrument values. Taking the measurements stays.
tasks.still_hard: A force number that is real and a posture the video shows was staged.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer ran the measurement and knows which trial to discard.
tasks.altitude: Measurement sessions stay. The engineer can refuse a note that treats a video as a performance record.

reach.task: Use the same time study for a line balance
reach.learn: Which trials were normal work and which were for the camera

evidence.claim: Recording work so as to check behaviour or performance needs works-council consent.
The engineer stays responsible for a finding that names a hazard, a person, or a design change.
Force and posture are measured on the person; a table does not collect them.

assumptions: Focal role is the human factors engineer. Boundary: from a task description to an analysis note. Redesigning the workplace is out of scope.
Structured fields are trial, force, posture code and video reference. The engineer produces the readings. Fallback: a reading that did not transfer is typed and marked manual.
Video that checks behaviour or performance needs works-council consent. It is not a score.
unknowns: Whether video is permitted at all.
Which anthropometric data already exist for this population.
research_questions: Which tasks need a force gauge rather than a checklist?

already_counted.description: Interpreting trials the table cannot explain

incremental.description: Keep posture codes and instrument units stable

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A known checklist saves setup and tabulation. Force measurement, video and interpretation stay. The low case is a task that cannot be filmed or gauged as planned.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Rearrange fixtures or task sequences to cut discomfort.

steps.what: See the discomfort and physical hazards with the client.
Do the rearranging of workplace fixtures and task sequences.
Note the support given and the cycle change.

loop.input: Layout change and the trial comment
loop.output: Note of what moved and what the client said
loop.check: Engineer deletes a change that was not made
loop.stop: One draft; a benefit the client did not confirm is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The note must describe the visit, not a standard fix

tasks.design: The engineer still visits, sees the discomfort, and rearranges fixtures or the task sequence with the people who do the work. A short note in {DOCS} records only what was changed and what the client confirmed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The visit and the note were the same effort, rewritten afterwards.
tasks.enabler_now: The note can be drafted from the visit. Moving fixtures and changing the sequence stay physical.
tasks.still_hard: A neat layout that the person cannot use for the real cycle.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer tries the change with the client and stops one that only looks better.
tasks.altitude: The visit remains almost the whole task. The engineer can withhold a note that claims a benefit the client did not feel.

reach.task: Time the cycle before and after a sequence change
reach.learn: Whether the new sequence really shortened the cycle

evidence.claim: The engineer stays responsible for a finding that names a hazard, a person, or a design change.
Rearranging a workplace is physical support, not a document change.

assumptions: Focal role is the human factors engineer. Boundary: from the client's request to a note of what was changed on site. A full workstation design is out of scope.
Test a {DOCS} note template before custom code.
Structured fields are fixture, sequence step and client comment. The visit produces them. Fallback: the engineer writes the note by hand if the template does not fit.
No claim of a cycle saving without a timed check.
unknowns: Whether the client may move fixtures without facilities approval.
Who owns the tools that were moved.
research_questions: Which changes need a later timed study rather than a same-day note?

already_counted.description: Checking the note against the visit

incremental.description: Keep the note template from adding benefits that were not seen

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Almost all of this task is the visit and the rearranging. Only the note is shorter. The low case is a workplace where nothing can be moved on the day.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Test reports get faster to draft. Workplace recommendations, force measurements and on-site rearranging stay hands-on.
reach: Industrial engineers timing a changed cycle
skills_to_grow: Sending only conclusions the test supports
Recommending a task change rather than a judgement of a worker
Not treating video as a performance score
role.ambitious_version: People who were tested can see the same checked findings as the client, and a workplace note never becomes a score.
